content: Render Network (RNDR) distributed GPU rendering: creators submit standardized scene packages (e.g. .orbx) with payment escrowed in a smart contract; verification uses a 'Proof of Render' scheme where other network nodes spot-check/re-render frames or fragments and compare results via consensus before payment releases. This is redundancy/spot-check based, not exact-hash based, because renders are not bit-exact across nodes.
